theorems.name: Submission.weighted_mono_cutoff_first_variation
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (ρ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight → IsOpen U → V.HasMeanCurvatureIn U H → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h U → tsupport h ∩ closedBall ξ ρ ⊆ U → 0 < ρ → (∀ γ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → IsTestField U (fun x ↦ (h x * γ ‖x - ξ‖) • (x - ξ)) → ∫ x in U, (h x * ((n : ℝ) * γ ‖x - ξ‖ + ‖x - ξ‖ * deriv γ ‖x - ξ‖ * (1 - V.normalRadialSq ξ x)) + γ ‖x - ξ‖ * inner ℝ (x - ξ) (V.tangentialGradient h x)) ∂V.weight = -∫ x in U, h x * γ ‖x - ξ‖ * inner ℝ (x - ξ) (H x) ∂V.weight) → ∃ R A : ℝ, ρ < R ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable h (V.weight.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (V.normalRadialSq ξ) (V.weight.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ R, |h x| ≤ A ∧ |V.normalRadialSq ξ x| ≤ 1) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ inner ℝ (x - ξ) (V.tangentialGradient h x + h x • H x)) (closedBall ξ R) V.weight ∧ ∀ (ε : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → (1 + ε) * ρ < R → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ t, t ≤ 1 → φ t = 1) → (∀ t, 1 + ε ≤ t → φ t = 0) → ∀ τ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ ρ → (n : ℝ) * ∫ x, h x * φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ) ∂V.weight + ∫ x, h x * (1 - V.normalRadialSq ξ x) * (‖x - ξ‖ / τ * deriv φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ)) ∂V.weight + ∫ x, φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ) * inner ℝ (x - ξ) (V.tangentialGradient h x + h x • H x) ∂V.weight = 0
